evidence: A series of amorphous REScO 3 ﬁlms was deposited by atomic layer deposition (ALD) using rare earth (RE) b-diketonate precursors RE(thd) 3 (thd ¼ 2,2,6,6-tetramethyl-3,5-heptanedionato) together with ozone in an attempt to study the effect of the RE 3+ cation size on various ﬁlm properties.
